- When sentiment is high (≥0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., +5%+ in 3-5 days), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +3-4% above recent peak.
- If sentiment is low (≤0.33) and price is trending down, model often underestimates; add 1-2% buffer to avoid premature bottoming.
- Model frequently overreacts to short-term sentiment swings; smooth 3-5 day moving average before final forecast.
- If true outcome shows mean reversion (e.g., 3-5 days after peak, price drops 5-10%), model often fails to adjust; reduce forecast by 1-3% for next 3-5 days.
- When sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67), model tends to err on the side of overconfidence; use sentiment-weighted average of recent 3-day range instead of linear extrapolation.
